name: ClearSky Flight Oracle
description: Monitors scheduled commercial flights and reports departure facts on-chain for the ClearSky parametric flight-delay insurance protocol. Settlement moves on observed actual departure time only; every report carries a keccak256 commitment to the raw provider payload it was derived from, so any payout can be audited against its source.

reporting_policy.rationale: An estimate that is revised upward and then walked back would let a transient delay drain the vault. Only a recorded actual departure can trigger a payout.
reporting_policy.evidence: keccak256 of the raw provider response, submitted as dataHash with every status report
reporting_policy.immutability: A recorded departure is terminal. The agent never reports a flight back to a not-departed state, so a stale or rolled-forward provider record cannot void a claim already earned.
